market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$81k on May 5, $75k means ~7.5% drawdown from current. Such intramonth drawdowns are common in BTC. With 26 days left and elevated geopolitical risk (Iran/Hormuz), a temporary dip to $75k is plausible though current momentum is up.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether risk-off escalation causes broad crypto selling
